projects.title: ITS Systems Integration & Traffic Enforcement Support
projects.role: Field and systems engineering across cameras, LiDAR, sensors, control units, networking, databases, and software interfaces.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: traffic cameras, sensors, vehicles and backend integration

projects.title: Efficient Neural Network Architectures for Vehicle Type Classification
projects.status: Academic Research — Code Private During Assessment
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Efficient vehicle image classification: a central car, truck and motorcycle with compact layered neural-network glass tiles and restrained visual feature activation highlights.

projects.title: Vehicle Type Classification Using NGSIM US-101
projects.role: Data preprocessing, exploratory analysis, feature engineering, model comparison, hyperparameter optimisation, classification evaluation, and feature-importance analysis.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Freeway trajectory machine learning: miniature multilane freeway seen obliquely from above with cars and trucks, distinct luminous trajectory trails flowing into a compact data-analysis plane.

projects.title: Reconnaissance Robot — RGB-D Mapping & Remote Control
projects.role: End-to-end implementation: system design, programming, assembly, integration, testing and documentation.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: RGB-D reconnaissance mapping: a credible four-wheel compact rover with forward horizontal depth camera and electronics, next to a translucent cyan point-cloud representation of an indoor corridor.

projects.title: Autonomous Quadcopter UAV — Flight Control, Telemetry & FPV
projects.role: Team project covering propulsion sizing, airframe and electronics integration, sensor calibration, PID tuning, flight-mode and failsafe testing, telemetry and video systems, and technical documentation.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Autonomous UAV: a credible F450-style four-arm quadcopter with exactly four rotors, red and white arms, visible flight controller, GPS mast and FPV camera, with subtle waypoint arcs.

projects.title: Software-Defined Networking — Automation & Video Streaming
projects.role: End-to-end design, implementation, programming, testing and technical documentation.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Software-defined networking: three compact network switches and an elevated central controller directing two colored network paths, with one small video-stream tile.

projects.title: IMS Multimedia Services — VoIP, IPTV & VoLTE
projects.role: Team design, implementation and testing of the project; design, implementation and testing of the reproducible lab.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: IMS multimedia telecom: a desk IP phone, modern mobile handset and video screen arranged around a compact telecom server core, linked by restrained cyan paths.

projects.title: Software-Defined Data Center (SDDC) — Design & Implementation
projects.role: Team project covering design, implementation, configuration, testing and technical documentation, alongside a study of SDDC architecture, storage networking (DAS/NAS/SAN, FC, IP SAN), network virtualisation and cloud models.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Software-defined data center: three premium server racks, shared storage appliance and transparent virtual workload cubes arranged as a clear architectural scene.

projects.title: Embedded Systems & IoT — PIC Firmware and Peripheral Integration
projects.role: Real-time monitoring and control systems, sensor integration, telemetry, hardware configuration, functional testing, and technical validation.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Embedded IoT peripheral integration: central microcontroller development PCB connected to small sensor modules, segmented display and compact communications module.

projects.title: RFID Library Automation System (ISO 15693)
projects.role: Design, implementation and technical presentation of the system.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: RFID library automation: neatly arranged books with discreet embedded tag motifs beside an elegant RFID reader pad and library security gate.

projects.title: Solar Energy Systems — Design, Sizing & Deployment
projects.role: Load analysis, component sizing and selection, wiring and protection, and performance estimation.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Solar energy sizing and supply: a neat array of photovoltaic panels beside battery storage, charge controller and inverter, connected with clear cable routes.

projects.title: Industrial Automation & PLC-Based Control Systems
projects.role: The field layer measures level, pressure, flow and weight. PLC logic coordinates motors, valves and pumps, while HMI panels provide operator commands and SCADA provides alarms, trends and historical records.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: PLC industrial automation: a compact industrial control cabinet with modular PLC and input-output rails beside a short miniature conveyor with sensors and an HMI.

projects.title: Embedded EEPROM Data Storage & Retrieval System
projects.role: The firmware separates the value being measured or entered from the stored byte. Read-back verifies persistence, while the display exposes the retrieved value to the operator.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Embedded EEPROM persistence: precision PCB with a small eight-pin EEPROM chip prominently in foreground connected to a microcontroller and restrained floating memory-block motifs.

projects.title: Monitoring & Diagnostics Console — VB.NET
projects.role: The console presents device and system condition in one operational view. Its role is to support fault recognition, diagnosis and follow-up across multiple sites.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Desktop monitoring application cover: an elegant desktop monitor showing a polished abstract diagnostic interface with status tiles, node-health visualization and small trend lines, without text or numeric readings.

projects.title: Service Operations & Technical Documentation Management System
projects.role: The source interface shows device records, repair details and warranty/calibration fields. These records connect the equipment identity with the work performed and the documents needed for follow-up.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Service operations desktop application: an elegant desktop monitor displaying abstract repair job cards and document panels, beside a small repair tool and electronic device, no written text or numbers.

projects.title: RF Link Budget & Propagation Analysis Engine
projects.role: The tool relates transmit power, antenna gains and propagation loss to the receive level used in link assessment. Its screenshot belongs to a standalone calculator rather than the monitoring application.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: RF link-budget software cover: a sleek monitor with an abstract signal-power waterfall and parameter blocks, alongside transmitting and receiving antenna miniatures linked by a fading wave.

projects.title: Line-of-Sight & Fresnel Zone Wireless Planning Tool
projects.role: Line-of-sight establishes the direct path between antennas. Fresnel analysis examines clearance around that path, giving the planner a different view from a power-only link budget.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Fresnel line-of-sight planning: two antenna towers on opposite terrain ridges with a clean translucent ellipsoidal Fresnel zone and a single center line spanning the valley.

projects.title: Enterprise Wireless & Network Infrastructure Architecture
projects.role: The architecture connects local users and infrastructure services through wireless and wired access. Routing and VPN connectivity provide the site-to-site boundary.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Enterprise network infrastructure: an elegant miniature office campus with connected access points, a central network switch and secure segmented colored network zones.

projects.title: Wireless Coverage & Point-to-Point Network Planning
projects.role: Coverage describes where access is available; point-to-point planning describes the transport between sites. Antenna placement and alignment influence both the proposed link and its installation.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: Wireless coverage planning: a radio mast over a detailed miniature terrain map with tasteful translucent coverage contour bands and a distant point-to-point receiving antenna.

projects.title: Network Infrastructure Design — MPLS Backbone
projects.role: OSPF provides the routing underlay. MPLS carries labelled traffic, while VRFs separate customer routing contexts and MP-BGP exchanges VPN routes.
projects.coverAlt: Illustrated cover: MPLS provider backbone: a coherent ring of premium network router appliances with distinct colored logical label-switched paths and two small edge-site nodes.
